The '''Shedra Line''' was a [[commutube]] line in [[Umgul City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umgul/Legends|Umgul]]. The Shedra Line cut through the city, connecting the districts of [[Furgan (Umgul City)|Furgan]] and [[Ganterville]], and connecting with the [[Katsu Line]] at two points.
